items.heading: Read the Notice for Your
items.text: Read the Notice for Your Read the notice for your state. Nursing, BPT and B.Pharm rules differ by state. Read the official notice, not a WhatsApp forward.

items.heading: The Boundary Moves Every Year,
items.text: The boundary moves every year, so save this table and check the last column on the official page. It also shows a rare thing: two neighbouring states running the same course through opposite step.

items.heading: Ask for the Seat, Not
items.text: Ask for the Seat, Not Ask for the Seat, Not Ask for the seat, not the dream. Ask your child to name the one seat they would happily take and the marks gap to it. Then check the gap table above together.

items.heading: Price the Year, Not Just
items.text: Price the year, not just the fee. A drop year costs coaching, living and one year of delayed pay. Compare the total with your education budget.

items.heading: Keep the Loan Rule Strict
items.text: Keep the loan rule strict. Avoid education loans unless the course is legally necessary and the fee is proportionate to realistic early pay.
